data.one_liner: Web implementation of Firebase Authentication for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides Firebase Auth functionality on web platforms, integrating with Firebase services via the web SDK.
use_when: Need Firebase Authentication on a Flutter web app
Require official Firebase Auth support for web
Want to use Firebase Auth features like sign-in, sign-out, and user management on web
avoid_when: Building a custom web auth solution without Firebase
strengths: Official Firebase package, ensuring compatibility with Firebase services
Keeps up-to-date with Firebase SDK changes
Integrates seamlessly with firebase_core and firebase_auth
weaknesses: Only supports web; no mobile support
Requires firebase_core and firebase_auth to be added separately
Relies on Firebase web SDK, which may have limitations compared to native SDKs
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_core and firebase_auth to pubspec, then import firebase_auth_web in web-specific code.
